C:\mingw64\bin\cmake.exe -E rm -f CMakeFiles\webpmux.dir/objects.a
C:\mingw64\bin\ar.exe qc CMakeFiles\webpmux.dir/objects.a @CMakeFiles\webpmux.dir\objects1.rsp
C:\mingw64\bin\gcc.exe  -pthread -O3 -DNDEBUG -Wl,--whole-archive CMakeFiles\webpmux.dir/objects.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive -o webpmux.exe -Wl,--out-implib,libwebpmux.dll.a -Wl,--major-image-version,0,--minor-image-version,0 @CMakeFiles\webpmux.dir\linkLibs.rsp
